notes: Clean lane: no new claims. All 22 manifest files were read in full; every candidate defect in the policy engine, registry, git helpers and configserver matched an open known.json row (by file and substance) and is carried by the dispatcher. Cross-chunk checks for the station: (1) correctness-160: LoadFragment/ExpandInstallMarkers exist in internal/config, but their use in the server's sectionOverridden/handleConfig compare loads and revert copy is in internal/server and was not verified here. (2) peek.SessionsByCwd was renamed to SessionIndex (ByCwd/ByBranch); the server callers and the branch-attribution concept are outside this chunk, and no spec item traces SessionIndex/GitBranch (see known correctness-INF-2-r2). (3) EvalDir.Dir now holds a nested '<skill>/<date>-<hash>' path built with filepath.Join (a backslash on Windows); server/skill_tests.go matches it by the ?d= query value, so it works only while templates pass Dir through unchanged. Not a finding.
